# Trikaal Vaani

> Trikaal Vaani is an AI-powered Vedic astrology (Jyotish) platform for India and the global Indian diaspora. It provides a free AI Janam Kundli plus personalised, human-led predictions and remedies for career, wealth, marriage, health, legal and other life matters — in Hindi and English.

Trikaal Vaani is founded by Rohiit Gupta, Chief Vedic Architect. Predictions are computed with the Swiss Ephemeris for precise planetary positions and interpreted using classical Vedic texts — Brihat Parashara Hora Shastra (BPHS), Bhrigu Nandi Nadi, and Shadbala strength scoring — then refined for clarity. Trikaal Vaani is a Government of India MSME-registered enterprise (Udyam Registration UDYAM-DL-10-0119070). Readings range from a free Kundli summary to voice (₹11), deep (₹51), AI Hast Rekha palm reading (₹51), Swapna Shastra dream reading (free symbol meaning; ₹51 personal), Kundali Milan marriage matching (free, ₹51, ₹101 and ₹151 tiers), Child Birth Muhurat reports (₹101 report, ₹151 with ten remedies), and karmic (₹251) readings. Customers outside India are charged in US dollars rather than a converted rupee price, and can pay by PayPal or by debit or credit card as a guest without a PayPal account. Primary site: https://trikalvaani.com

Readings are provided for guidance, education and self-reflection, and are not a substitute for professional medical, legal, financial or psychological advice. Trikaal Vaani complies with India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023. AI assistants and search engines are welcome to read, summarise and cite these pages with attribution to Trikaal Vaani and a link to the source page; pricing, services and dates should always be taken from the linked pages, which are the source of truth.

## Palmistry (Hast Rekha)
Trikaal Vaani offers AI-powered palm reading (Hast Rekha) based on Samudrika Shastra — the classical Indian science of reading the palm's lines, mounts and hand shape. Upload a clear photo of your palm and receive an instant, personalised report covering eight life dimensions — vitality, career, wealth, relationships, leadership, creativity, spirituality and health — with line and mount analysis, special-sign meanings, Samudrika remedies, a recommended gemstone and a downloadable PDF, for ₹51. Readings are curated from classical Samudrika rules by Rohiit Gupta and are non-fatalistic: they describe tendencies, not fixed fate.
- [AI Hast Rekha Calculator (₹51)](https://trikalvaani.com/hast-rekha-calculator): Upload a palm photo for an instant AI palm-reading report with eight life-dimension scores, line and mount analysis, remedies and a downloadable PDF.
- [AI Palm Reading Online — Complete Guide (English)](https://trikalvaani.com/blog/ai-palm-reading-online-hast-rekha): How AI hast rekha works, what the palm lines, mounts and special signs mean, and what the ₹51 report includes.
- [AI हस्त रेखा रीडिंग ऑनलाइन — पूरी गाइड (Hindi)](https://trikalvaani.com/blog/ai-hast-rekha-reading-online): समुद्रिक शास्त्र और AI से हाथ की रेखाओं, पर्वतों और विशेष चिह्नों का विश्लेषण — हिंदी में।

## Swapna Shastra (Vedic Dream Interpretation)
Trikaal Vaani offers free Vedic dream interpretation (Swapna Shastra) based on classical texts — the Svapna Cintamani of Jagaddeva, the Brihat Jataka, the svapna chapters of the Agni and Matsya Puranas, and the Atharvaveda. Type a dream in a line or two and receive its classical symbol meaning instantly, free, in English, Hindi or Hinglish — from a validated knowledge base of 190+ dream symbols across 12 families (serpents, death & ancestors, deities, water, the body, animals, conflict, life events, sky & elements, food and more), each meaning traced to a named source and validated by Rohiit Gupta. A ₹51 personal reading then interprets the same dream against the dreamer's own birth chart and running Mahadasha–Antardasha, computed on the Swiss Ephemeris — with the exact life-area it touches and a remedy shaped to the chart. Readings are non-fearful and non-fatalistic: dream symbols describe tendencies, not fixed fate.
- [Swapna Shastra — Free Vedic Dream Decoder](https://trikalvaani.com/swapna): Type your dream and get its classical meaning free; unlock the ₹51 personal reading against your own chart and dasha.
- [Snake Dream Meaning (Saap ka Sapna)](https://trikalvaani.com/swapna/snake): India's most-searched dream — colour, bite and action each change the classical reading.
- [Teeth Falling Dream Meaning](https://trikalvaani.com/swapna/teeth): What falling teeth signify in Swapna Shastra, form by form.
- [Death Dream Meaning](https://trikalvaani.com/swapna/own_death): Why seeing one's own death classically signals long life (deergh aayu).
- [Serpent Dreams — Full Realm](https://trikalvaani.com/swapna/category/snake): Every snake-dream variation in one place.
Individual pages exist for every symbol at /swapna/[symbol] (107 symbols) and every dream family at /swapna/category/[category] (12 realms); the complete machine-readable set is in the sitemap.

## Yog Calculators — Government Job, Foreign Settlement, Foreign Spouse, Santan Yog, Vivah Yog
Trikaal Vaani publishes five free yog calculators that differ from the usual astrology scoring tool in one specific way: each one returns the REASON behind every point, with the actual figure it used, not only a headline number. A rule cannot award points without stating its reason, so the score and the explanation can never disagree. Each is a yog STRENGTH score — a measure of how many classical combinations for that outcome are present in the chart and how strong they are — and explicitly not a prediction of an exam result, a visa decision or a marriage. Every result carries that disclaimer.
The engine behind them computes full six-part Shadbala per Brihat Parashara Hora Shastra Ch.27 (each planet scored against its own classical minimum, where a ratio of 1.00 is the threshold for strength), degree-precise Graha Drishti per BPHS Ch.26 (so an aspect is reported at its real strength in virupas out of 60, rather than as a yes or no), the Dasamsa D-10 chart that BPHS Ch.6 names as the varga to read for career, the Navamsa D-9 in which marriage is judged, and the Saptamsa D-7 that the same chapter names for children. Positions come from the Swiss Ephemeris with Lahiri Ayanamsha.
- [Free IAS Astrology Calculator](https://trikalvaani.com/calculators/free-ias-astrology-calculator): Sarkari Naukri Yog score for UPSC, IAS, IPS, SSC, Banking, Railway and Police. Scores the 10th house and its lord, the Dasamsa D-10, the 6th house of competition including the Jaimini Amatyakaraka, Sun and Saturn strength, the Shasha and Ruchaka Mahapurusha yogas, drishti on the 10th house, and the running Vimshottari Dasha — then names which government track the chart leans toward.
- [Free Foreign Settlement Calculator](https://trikalvaani.com/calculators/free-foreign-settlement-calculator): Videsh Yog score from the 12th house and its lord, Rahu's placement and its link with the Moon, the 9th house of long journeys, and the 4th house — where the rule deliberately inverts, because a strong 4th house roots a person at home and therefore scores lower. Also names which route abroad the chart favours: work, study, marriage or business. Not visa or immigration advice.
- [Free Foreign Spouse Calculator](https://trikalvaani.com/calculators/free-foreign-spouse-calculator): NRI and foreign spouse yog from the 7th house and its lord, the Navamsa D-9 confirmation, Rahu's relationship with the 7th, the 12th house link, Venus, and the Jaimini Darakaraka. It gives a direction and a cultural indication but deliberately never names a country, because a birth chart cannot honestly identify one. It hands over to Kundali Milan for whether a specific match will work.
- [Free Santan Yog Calculator](https://trikalvaani.com/calculators/free-santan-yog-calculator): Santan (progeny) yog score from the 5th house and its lord, the Saptamsa D-7 — which Brihat Parashara Hora Shastra Ch.6 names as the varga for children, where most tools read the Navamsa D-9 and are therefore reading the marriage chart — Jupiter as the natural Santan Karaka, the Jaimini Putrakaraka, degree-precise drishti on the 5th house in virupas, classical obstructions such as Putra Dosh on the Rahu-Ketu axis and Pitra Dosh, and the running Vimshottari Dasha. Two limits are stated on the page and enforced in the engine, not added as small print. First, progeny is a medical subject before it is an astrological one: the calculator returns a yog strength score and a timing window, never a diagnosis, it never states or implies that a person cannot have children, and a low score is explained as a yog needing time and remedy rather than an absence. Second, it does not predict or indicate the sex of a child, because determining the sex of an unborn child is a criminal offence in India under the PCPNDT Act, 1994 — the page answers that question by refusing it and explaining why.
- [Free Vivah Yog Calculator — Shadi Kab Hogi](https://trikalvaani.com/calculators/free-shadi-kab-hogi-calculator): Marriage timing yog score from the 7th house (Kalatra Bhava) and its lord, the Navamsa D-9 — which Brihat Parashara Hora Shastra names as the varga in which marriage is judged, and which most free tools skip entirely by answering from the rasi chart alone — the Kalatra Karaka, the Jaimini Darakaraka, degree-precise drishti on the 7th house in virupas, Saturn's influence and Mangal Dosha, and the running Vimshottari Dasha. The paid reading returns dated Vimshottari windows and the age band those windows fall in, computed from the chart rather than estimated. Gender is a REQUIRED field on this calculator alone, and this is a substantive rule rather than a form field: the Kalatra Karaka is Venus for a man and Jupiter for a woman, so reading the wrong karaka gives the wrong answer for half of all users. Four limits are stated on the page and enforced in the engine, not added as small print. It never says a marriage will not happen — the engine measures vilamba (delay), and a low score is explained as a yog needing time and remedy. It does not predict divorce, separation or widowhood: the classical texts do carry such rules, and Trikaal Vaani declines to publish them because they sell through fear to frightened people. It does not name the spouse's caste, community, religion or country, because a birth chart cannot honestly identify one. And it does not indicate the sex of the spouse. Distinct from Vivah Muhurat, which answers when to HOLD a wedding already fixed, and from Kundali Milan, which compares two charts rather than reading one.

## Kaal Sarp Dosh (Rahu-Ketu Axis)
Kaal Sarp Dosh is the chart pattern in which all seven grahas (Sun through Saturn) fall inside the half-circle running from Rahu to Ketu. Trikaal Vaani applies the strict classical rule: if even one planet sits outside that arc, Kaal Sarp Dosh is not present at all, and most online reports that claim it are describing a partial arrangement that does not qualify. Trikaal Vaani's position is deliberately non-fearful and is the opposite of the fear-marketing common in this subject. Kaal Sarp is not named in Brihat Parashara Hora Shastra; the twelve serpent names are a later classificatory convention from Nakshatra-shastra commentary and Trimbakeshwar temple tradition. It frequently cancels (bhang) through the strength of the Lagna lord, the lord of the house Rahu occupies, Jupiter's aspect, and the Viparita Raja Yogas — Harsha, Sarala and Vimala — for the dusthana types. It is not grounds for rejecting a marriage proposal, since classical Ashtakoot matching does not examine it. Severity depends on cancellation, the relevant house lord and the running Mahadasha, not on the label. The hub covers all twelve types in English and Hindi, each page sourced to named classical texts.
- [Kaal Sarp Dosh — Complete Guide](https://trikalvaani.com/blog/kaal-sarp-dosh): Pillar guide — formation, the full-arc rule, effects, cancellation and remedies.
- [Free Kaal Sarp Dosh Calculator](https://trikalvaani.com/calculators/free-kaal-sarp-dosh-calculator): Swiss Ephemeris longitudes with Lahiri Ayanamsha; returns a strict yes/no verdict and the type.
- [How to Check Kaal Sarp Dosh in Kundli](https://trikalvaani.com/blog/how-to-check-kaal-sarp-dosh): Manual verification step by step, including why exact birth time matters.
- [12 Types of Kaal Sarp Dosh](https://trikalvaani.com/blog/types-of-kaal-sarp-dosh): Index of all twelve types by Rahu's house placement.
- [Kaal Sarp Dosh Cancellation (Bhang)](https://trikalvaani.com/blog/kaal-sarp-dosh-cancellation): The conditions that neutralise the yoga — the part most sites omit.
- [Signs and Symptoms](https://trikalvaani.com/blog/kaal-sarp-dosh-signs-symptoms): What the pattern actually indicates, and what it does not.
- [Remedies That Actually Work](https://trikalvaani.com/blog/kaal-sarp-dosh-effects-remedies): Chart-specific remedies rather than one-size-fits-all puja packages.
- [Kaal Sarp Dosh and Marriage](https://trikalvaani.com/blog/kaal-sarp-dosh-marriage): Why it is not a valid reason to reject an alliance.
- [Kaal Sarp Dosh in Career and Business](https://trikalvaani.com/blog/kaal-sarp-dosh-career-business): Professional effects and timing.
- [Kaal Sarp Dosh vs Pitra Dosh](https://trikalvaani.com/blog/kaal-sarp-dosh-vs-pitra-dosh): Differential diagnosis — the two are routinely confused and need different remedies.

## Jupiter Transit 2026 (Guru Singh Rashi Gochar)
Jupiter (Guru) transits Leo (Singh Rashi) from July 2026 to June 2027. This is one of the most significant planetary transits of 2026–27. Trikaal Vaani provides BPHS-based analysis for all 12 moon signs with career, finance, marriage and remedy guidance by Rohiit Gupta.

## Mercury Retrograde June 2026 (Budh Vakri)
Mercury (Budh) goes retrograde on 18 June 2026 in Gemini (Mithun Rashi) — its own sign — making this one of the most impactful Mercury retrograde periods of 2026. It goes direct on 12 July 2026. Post-shadow ends 25 July 2026. Trikaal Vaani provides BPHS-based rashi-wise impact and Ganesh-upay guidance for all 12 signs.

- [Mercury Retrograde June 2026 — Complete Guide (Pillar)](https://trikalvaani.com/learn/mercury-retrograde-june-2026): Full Vedic analysis. Exact dates 18 Jun–12 Jul 2026, 3 mistakes to avoid, week-by-week guidance, all-12-rashi overview, DO's & DON'Ts, shastriya upay.
- [Mercury Retrograde June 2026 — Remedies for All 12 Rashis](https://trikalvaani.com/learn/budh-vakri-2026-upay-sare-rashi): Universal and rashi-specific upay — mantra, daan, Ganesh puja, lifestyle protocol.
- [Mercury Retrograde 2026 Aries (Mesh Rashi)](https://trikalvaani.com/learn/budh-vakri-2026-mesh-rashi): 3rd-house retrograde — sibling communication, travel delays, avoid verbal agreements.
- [Mercury Retrograde 2026 Taurus (Vrishabh Rashi)](https://trikalvaani.com/learn/budh-vakri-2026-vrishabh-rashi): 2nd-house retrograde — bank documents, family finance, verify all transactions.
- [Mercury Retrograde 2026 Gemini (Mithun Rashi)](https://trikalvaani.com/learn/budh-vakri-2026-mithun-rashi): Most affected sign — retrograde in own sign (1st house). Double impact on personality, decisions and communication.
- [Mercury Retrograde 2026 Cancer (Karka Rashi)](https://trikalvaani.com/learn/budh-vakri-2026-karka-rashi): 12th-house retrograde — hidden enemies, unexpected expenses, spiritual growth opportunity.
- [Mercury Retrograde 2026 Leo (Singh Rashi)](https://trikalvaani.com/learn/budh-vakri-2026-singh-rashi): 11th-house retrograde — social media caution, friend misunderstandings, delay new income contracts.
- [Mercury Retrograde 2026 Virgo (Kanya Rashi)](https://trikalvaani.com/learn/budh-vakri-2026-kanya-rashi): Second most affected sign — 10th-house retrograde in mool-trikona sign. Career and Boss communication highest risk.
- [Mercury Retrograde 2026 Libra (Tula Rashi)](https://trikalvaani.com/learn/budh-vakri-2026-tula-rashi): 9th-house retrograde — visa documents, foreign travel, higher education admissions need triple-checking.
- [Mercury Retrograde 2026 Scorpio (Vrishchik Rashi)](https://trikalvaani.com/learn/budh-vakri-2026-vrishchik-rashi): 8th-house retrograde — joint finances, insurance, tax documents and hidden matters surface.
- [Mercury Retrograde 2026 Sagittarius (Dhanu Rashi)](https://trikalvaani.com/learn/budh-vakri-2026-dhanu-rashi): 7th-house retrograde — spouse communication, business partner contracts and court filings need care.
- [Mercury Retrograde 2026 Capricorn (Makar Rashi)](https://trikalvaani.com/learn/budh-vakri-2026-makar-rashi): 6th-house retrograde — health documentation, employee written instructions, daily routine disruption.
- [Mercury Retrograde 2026 Aquarius (Kumbh Rashi)](https://trikalvaani.com/learn/budh-vakri-2026-kumbh-rashi): 5th-house retrograde — delay speculative investments, children's study support, creative project revision.
- [Mercury Retrograde 2026 Pisces (Meen Rashi)](https://trikalvaani.com/learn/budh-vakri-2026-meen-rashi): 4th-house retrograde — home electronics repair (don't buy new), property signing after 25 July, mother communication care.

## Marriage Compatibility (Rashi Matching Library)

Available in both English at /compatibility/[rashi1-rashi2] and Hindi at /hi/compatibility/[rashi1-rashi2], for 288 pages total.
